instruction.name: vshuf.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, shuffle bytes from `a` and `b` using the low 5 bits of the indices from the corresponding lane of `c`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4
